verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents its own bulk endpoints: an 'Ingest Usage Events in Batch' endpoint for bulk submissions, and asynchronous Export jobs that output data in bulk. Bulk operations are only evidenced for these narrow resource types, not as a general capability across items. Missing for 10: general bulk create/update/delete across subscriptions, customers or invoices; batch limits and error-handling docs; AI/MCP-driven bulk actions; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Ingest a Usage Event for individual events and Ingest Usage Events in Batch for bulk submissions
Export operations are asynchronous and will return "Export" resource in response
